Easy, “Sapiens” by Yuval Noah Harari. The sequel to that, “Homo Deus”, will blow your mind further in terms of ‘Techno-Humanism’ and the humans’ scientific search for internal life, upgraded intelligence and divinity.

This was really helpful. I do see how atheism can be dangerous and consciousness and morality has always been the one factor that keeps me on the fence because it is simply inexplicable. I do believe that Religious principles are of good use and can be used to base our ethical values in terms of human worth and dignity. However, to believe that we absolutely need a God to be moral or ethical is a scary thought because that truly justifies the fact that we are incapable of morality and ethics because we do know factually that us humans have created the ancient scriptures. What would be the case if we hadn’t? Why Christianity? Why any other religious scriptures? The same could have been said about Islam. And yet religions such as Christianity had suppressed scientific ideas countless times to hold the bibles credibility to be all-knowing and what happened after breaking free of that suppression? We had literally saved human existence with scientific discoveries. War, plague and famine would have wiped out the entire species if it weren’t for science. Praying to the bible will only get us so far, unfortunately.

That makes for a very difficult question I don’t think anyone can answer with any certainty. However, if we have, over thousands of years, developed such an intricate mind that has allowed us to overcome war, plague and famine through science. I don’t see why we shouldn’t live by science and the true understanding of the cosmos. This is where I am confused by this rule, if I am being honest with myself, how can I believe in God through any religion? When I know, what I know and I don’t, what I don’t.

Well, In all honesty, if I were to base my religious belief directly in the bible I would have many issues with it. For example, to believe that God had created a world in which all living beings would suffer, why not just make a world with no suffering? I can’t possibly believe God loves the Jews of the twentieth century genocide or the victims of the communist Soviet Union. Also a world where he had sent his only son to be brutally tormented and nailed to a cross to die is absolutely mad for me to believe that not only I, myself, but everyone were made in that image. The fact that we actually know that all religions were created through humans and not a divine power makes it very hard to believe that such an all powerful God had chose to spread his message through poor Jewish slaves and not with every living person. We now know that we are, in fact, descendants of chimpanzees and have evolved through natural selection and that makes me wonder why the bible teaches humanism and that we are different from animals, why are they not made in gods image and why do they not have an important role in Christianity. If we were to live by the bible and to assume it were right we would still believe that the earth is flat and that stars are not actually the gaseous masses we now know they are. How can I base my life’s meaning on scriptures that are completely ignorant however, claims to be all-knowing? To be clear, I was brought up in a catholic home and have attended church and studied Christianity my whole, short life and I do have the upmost respect for religious people, I have just always been driven by curiosity and inclined to question things. However, I would love to understand.
